### 页面标题
- **NDA scenario analysis**

### 表格（4列：Scenarios / Pros / Cons / Mitagation plan）

#### Scenario #1 (Global Goal)
- **内容**：Adolescent and adult recruitment completes simultaneously; and the labelled population includes 12 year and older patients with BE (**no sNDA**).
- **Pros**
  - Simultaneous completion of recruitment, saving cost and budget;
  - One DBL + One NDA + Broader Population (12y and older)
  - (China) Priority review, NRDL premium pricing
- **Cons**
  - NA
- **Mitagation plan**
  - NA

#### Scenario #2
- **内容**：Adolescent recruitment completes much later than adult recruitment (DBL 1 for adults and DBL 2 for adols.); but the available adolescent data at DBL 1 is sufficient to support label inclusion of adols (**no sNDA**).
- **Pros**
  - Same as above
- **Cons**
  - Medium to high risk of sNDA, depending on the data totality;
  - China HA may have objections as well
- **Mitagation plan**
  - China contribution more adols. & CF patients. (see next slide)

#### Scenario #3
- **内容**：Adolescent recruitment completes much later than adult recruitment (DBL 1 for adults and DBL 2 for adols.); but the available adolescent data at DBL 1 is **NOT** sufficient to support label inclusion of adols (**sNDA**).
- **Pros**
  - NA
- **Cons**
  - (China)Chance for Priority review, NRDL premium pricing will be much lower
- **Mitagation plan**
  - （该列可见内容为空）
